newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends up but under key resistance.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends up but under key resistance.

text.p: Fund buying buoyed CSCE world sugar futures to 13-week highs, but producer selling blocked the March contract from piercing resistance at 11.00 cents on the close, dealers said.
The March contract settled 0.10 cent a lb firmer at 10.99 cents, its higest close since 11.04 on Sept 24. The back months ended 0.08 to 0.02 firmer.
Volume was estimated at a brisk 23,772 lots.
Floor sources said today's settlement at the highs could signal firmer prices Tuesday and a potential move over 11.00 cents, where fresh fund buying is expected to emerge.
Firmer resistance was seen at 11.05 cents and suppoprt at the recent low of 10.63 cents made Dec 19, basis the March contract.
Tuesday, sugar futures will stop trading at 1120 EST/1620 GMT. The CSCE will be closed New Year's Day and will reopen Thursday.
